summary: Implemented Graph.cbd(resource) in rdflib/graph.py as the last method of Graph, before ConjunctiveGraph. It uses a nested recursive helper add_to_cbd: rule 1 adds subject triples and recurses into BNode objects (type(o) is BNode) that the result doesn't yet describe; rule 2 adds all triples of every rdf:subject reifier of the node, without recursing. Added test/test_graph_cbd.py (class CbdTestCase) with an inline Turtle fixture and tests for rule 1/2 counts, typed and untyped reifiers, incoming reification exclusion, blank node in reifier not expanded, blank-node cycle, and source immutability. Nothing was run or committed, per instructions. Unverified: Graph.close() availability in tearDown and the Turtle nested blank-node parsing; the test expectations were computed by hand.
